title: Seylo service export, format 1
description: The files inside a service export (.zip): manifest.json (manifest), manifest.sig (signature), services/<name>/service.json (service), secrets.enc (envelope) and the plaintext inside it (secrets).

secrets.description: encrypted: settings and secret values are in secrets.enc under a passphrase. omitted: settings in clear, secret values left out.

name.description: DNS-safe; the service's host name on the project network. Unique in its project.

kind.description: Compose members have kind app and a parentId naming their stack.

name.description: DNS-safe; the service's host name on the project network. Unique in its project.

kind.description: Compose members have kind app and a parentId naming their stack.

url.description: https://, ssh:// or git@host:path URL, without a token or password in it (use a git credential).
url.errorMessage: put no user name, token or password in a git URL; store it as a git credential and pick that instead

init.description: Init process. auto (default): Docker's init (Tini) as PID 1, forwarding stop signals to the app and reaping zombies, unless the image runs its own init as PID 1 (its entrypoint, or command without one, is s6-overlay's /init, another init or systemd, tini, dumb-init, docker-init, catatonit or s6-*). on: always. off: never. Applies on the next deploy.

restart.description: Off = stay stopped after the first crash.

items.description: DNS-safe; the service's host name on the project network. Unique in its project.

host.description: Lower-case host name without scheme or port, for example shop.example.com.

pathPrefix.description: Only requests under this path match. "/" is the whole host.

anyOf.description: Lower-case host name without scheme or port, for example shop.example.com.

message.description: Short text shown on the default page.

concurrency.description: When a run is still going at the next tick: skip the new one, run both, or stop the old one.
